title: Capilliposide A attenuates diabetic nephropathy via modulation of NF-kappaB/TLR4 and apoptotic pathways.
authors: Man, Xueli; Wang, Luping; Liao, Huajun; Pan, Xin; Jin, Juan; He, Qiang; Tian, Jingkui; Ma, Jiahui
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过网络药理学和分子对接研究Capilliposide A对糖尿病肾病的NF-kB/TLR4通路调节，虽含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to identify therapeutic targets and signaling pathways of Capilliposide A (LC-A) for diabetic nephropathy (DN) through integrated network pharmacology and experimental validation. Using a DN mouse model induced by high-fat diet (HFD) and streptozotocin (STZ), we investigated the molecular mechanisms of LC-A. The PubChem database provided the two-dimensional structure of LC-A, with subsequent identification of LC-A/DN-associated targets through intersection analysis. Core targets were determined via protein-protein interaction (PPI) network construction, followed by gene ontology enrichment and pathway analyses. Molecular docking simulations evaluated LC-A's binding affinity to DN-related targets. C57BL/6 mice receiving HFD and STZ intraperitoneal injections were treated daily with LC-A or metformin (MET) via oral gavage for 8 weeks. Weekly monitoring included body weight and blood glucose measurements. Post-treatment assessments encompassed serum lipid profiles, renal function biomarkers, inflammatory cytokines, oxidative stress markers, and renal histopathology. Western blotting, immunohistochemistry, and immunofluorescence were performed to analyze inflammatory pathway proteins and apoptosis-related factors. Network pharmacology identified TLR4, NF-kappaB1, STAT3, EGFR, mTOR, and MAPK as core targets involved in inflammation, oxidative stress, and apoptosis regulation. Pathway enrichment analysis revealed critical inflammatory pathways including IL-17, TNF, and Th17 cell differentiation. Molecular docking confirmed stable binding of LC-A to TLR4, NF-kappaB1, Bax, and Bcl-2. In vivo experiments demonstrated that LC-A significantly reduced renal injury markers (KI, SCR, BUN), lipid profiles (TG, TC), and oxidative stress (MDA), while enhancing antioxidant enzymes (SOD, GPX, CAT) in DN mice (P < 0.05). LC-A effectively suppressed serum inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, MCP-1, iNOS) through NF-kappaB pathway modulation and apoptosis regulation (P < 0.05). Histopathological analysis revealed attenuated renal cortical vacuolization, tubular swelling, glomerular mesangial expansion, sclerosis, and inflammatory infiltration. These findings suggest LC-A as a promising natural nephroprotective agent for DN prevention and treatment.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过整合网络药理学与实验验证，识别毛蕊花苷A（LC-A）治疗糖尿病肾病（DN）的靶点及信号通路。利用高脂饮食（HFD）和链脲佐菌素（STZ）诱导的DN小鼠模型，我们探讨了LC-A的分子机制。PubChem数据库提供了LC-A的二维结构，并通过交集分析确定了LC-A/DN相关靶点。通过蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）网络构建确定核心靶点，随后进行基因本体富集和通路分析。分子对接模拟评估了LC-A与DN相关靶点的结合亲和力。接受HFD和STZ腹腔注射的C57BL/6小鼠，每日通过口服灌胃给予LC-A或二甲双胍（MET）治疗，持续8周。每周监测包括体重和血糖测量。治疗后评估涵盖血清脂质谱、肾功能生物标志物、炎症细胞因子、氧化应激标志物及肾脏组织病理学。采用Western blotting、免疫组织化学和免疫荧光分析炎症通路蛋白及凋亡相关因子。网络药理学确定TLR4、NF-kappaB1、STAT3、EGFR、mTOR和MAPK为参与炎症、氧化应激和凋亡调控的核心靶点。通路富集分析揭示了关键炎症通路，包括IL-17、TNF和Th17细胞分化。分子对接确认LC-A与TLR4、NF-kappaB1、Bax和Bcl-2稳定结合。体内实验表明，LC-A显著降低DN小鼠的肾损伤标志物（KI、SCR、BUN）、脂质谱（TG、TC）和氧化应激（MDA），同时增强抗氧化酶（SOD、GPX、CAT）（P < 0.05）。LC-A通过NF-kappaB通路调节和凋亡调控有效抑制血清炎症细胞因子（IL-6、TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、MCP-1、iNOS）（P < 0.05）。组织病理学分析显示，肾皮质空泡化、肾小管肿胀、肾小球系膜扩张、硬化和炎症浸润均有所减轻。这些发现表明LC-A是DN预防和治疗中一种有前景的天然肾脏保护剂。
